summary: Layer 1B expansion found one unusually direct US-listed pure-play candidate, PLPC, plus three context/adjacent names that map to transmission-line hardware, utility connectors, engineered transmission structures, or corrosion-protection dependencies. The highest-purity underfollowed lane is PLPC because its public product catalog directly covers transmission dead-ends, splices, suspension/support hardware, spacers, spacer dampers, motion-control products, OPGW/ADSS fiber hardware, and substation connectors. HUBB is a larger reference name with direct utility connector exposure but broader market attention. VMI and AZZ are adjacent chokepoint candidates: not fittings/clamps pure-plays, but they sit near mandatory transmission infrastructure BOM items such as engineered utility structures and hot-dip galvanizing for transmission/distribution poles and lattice towers. No buy/sell recommendation is implied; this is a universe-expansion and evidence-prioritization pass only.
